lang-01-c3.text: J. J. O'Connor and E. F. Robertson (MacTutor, University of St Andrews) (2003). Laurent Lafforgue. MacTutor History of Mathematics Archive, University of St Andrews.
lang-01-c3.quote: Laurent Lafforgue was awarded the Fields Medal for his proof of the Langlands correspondence
lang-01-c3.claim: Laurent Lafforgue extended this to all \(GL_n\) in 2002, earning a Fields Medal.

lang-06-c2.text: Peter Scholze (2010). The Local Langlands correspondence for GL_n over p-adic fields. arXiv.
lang-06-c2.quote: In contrast to the proofs of the Local Langlands Correspondence given by Henniart and Harris-Taylor our proof completely by-passes the numerical Local Langlands Correspondence of Henniart.

lang-06-c3.text: Laurent Fargues, Peter Scholze (2021). Geometrization of the local Langlands correspondence. arXiv.
lang-06-c3.quote: Following the idea of [Far16], we develop the foundations of the geometric Langlands program on the Fargues--Fontaine curve.
lang-06-c3.claim: recent breakthroughs include Fargues-Scholze's geometric construction of the local Langlands correspondence (2021)

lang-07-c3.text: Erica Klarreich (2024). Monumental Proof Settles Geometric Langlands Conjecture. Quanta Magazine.
lang-07-c3.quote: The proof involves more than 800 pages spread over five papers.
lang-07-c3.claim: The argument runs to roughly 800 pages across five papers
